correctness.rationale: The proof is a complete case split on a finite laminar multiset of fibres. An intermediate-size fibre gives a three-way pigeonhole argument. Without such a fibre, large fibres form a chain, while maximal small fibres are disjoint; a greedy union between one third and two thirds then yields an anti-complete rectangle. The three-type blow-up proves optimality. Exhaustive direct enumeration agrees for all side sizes at most four.
